title: A Room for the Harvest
author: E. M. Delacroix
blurb: August Villalobos, the new teacher at a school with a missing-class problem, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. Then the excavation crew unearths a door, sealed from the inside — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must hold out until sunrise with the truth about what was invited in before the well refills.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
